description: Search the live listings. Give a few words, and filters when the person mentioned them. Returns a few well-matched results; compare them for the person rather than listing everything. Prices are in each listing's own currency.

attributes.description: Filters on attributes from get_category, such as {"make": "BMW", "year": {"min": 2015}, "fuel": ["diesel", "hybrid"]} or {"grading": "psa", "grade": {"min": 9}}: enum and text take a value or a list (text matches part of the value), numbers {"min": , "max": } or one value, yes/no true or false, fits_years one year (parts that fit it), serial {"max": } (print run).

category.description: Category slug from list_categories (top level includes its subcategories).

near.description: Only listings with a map pin within radius_km (default 25) of this point.

postal_code.description: Postal code or its start, such as 1100 or SW1A.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "bamboo armchair".

region.description: State, province or district (matches part of it).

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
